A2: "The POAP as drawn on slide 3 (16 Jul 2026 deck), decomposed into technical steps per major line of work. Window statuses: POAP-DRAWN = bar drawn on the slide; ASSUMPTION = no bar exists (the work is costed but absent from the plan). Step statuses: DERIVED = step text and position follow from slide sub-items, named documents (slides 5-10) or the verified cost model; ASSUMPTION = position is sequencing judgement, text still sourced. TASK bars dilate with SlipWeeks ONLY on time-driven work (people schedules + Azure commissioning + any people LANE); a pure fixed-fee TASK bar (a RATE_MISSING-licence fold or a third-party pen-test/red-team engagement) SHIFTS under slip but keeps its drawn duration, matching the slip-cost model. STEP bars render RELATIVE to their parent task's live window, so a fixed licence STEP inside a time-driven lane (e.g. the procurement track) rides the lane and may widen with it — the fixed-does-not-stretch rule is a TASK-row property, not a step-row one.  Bars recalc live: SlipWeeks dilates TIME-DRIVEN windows (people + Azure commissioning) pro-rata — the same elongation the slip cost prices; FIXED-fee engagements (licences, third-party pen-test/red-team) shift but keep their duration; hypercare shifts whole. A ▶ in the Slip column flags any bar clipped at the grid edge under a large slip. Milestones: ▲ go-live (moves with slip) · ✕ Christmas · ! Bank holiday · ◆ drawn phase gate. Bar colours: SEGRO red · HCL dark blue · Azure mid blue · Third-party purple."
